text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Here's to another great
day!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for giving me some time off! I'm
totally
refreshed, and I even got to eat
my favorite
bento box. Now I'm all fired
up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You know what? You really need to try
Kyoto's
local inari bento too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's the best thing for when you need an
energy
boost! It's simple in taste, but it
never grows old!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Seeking the Pearl had a
fulfilling day
off and was able to indulge
in her favorite bento
box.
